fact: Digital Services Act, 2025 (Act No. 22 of 2025, an act of parliament) was passed by the National Assembly on 14 August 2025 and assented on 17 October 2025; it provides for public bodies exchanging data through an Information Gateway (s.22), a Framework for Secure Exchange of Information (s.12) and data retrieval between bodies (s.16), and its own text gives commencement as by Ministerial Order in the Gazette, with no commencement date stated in this document.

Digital Services Act, 2025 (Act No. 22 of 2025, an act) states that a public or private body shall avoid collecting information already held by another public or private body (s.16(4)) and that citizens and businesses are to give the same information only once, shared and reused as necessary (s.5(m)), with administrative penalties of up to P500,000 for non-compliance with Authority directions (s.34); the text says nothing of any order or regulation yet made under it.
